ns2:section.sectionText: Restriction: this course was previously taught as IS199 IMC – Intro to Managing Cybersecurity (SP 2022) or IS 199 IMC - Cyber Risk and Cybersecurity (SP 2023). Students who enrolled in the IS199 IMC versions are not eligible to enroll in IS234. Go to https://go.ischool.illinois.edu/CourseRegistrationRestrictions for information on enrollment restrictions. We will not provide overrides, please wait until the course restrictions are removed. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
